summary: Wasn’t really a portal room, but it had 3 portals, an altar/summoning restore, a bank, a shop for life/aura refreshes, and unlockables such as better tiers of bonfires, and adrenaline crystals by the portals that act as dummies on roids (gave you 25% adren every so often (looked like 1.8s but can’t say for sure))
